nodes.label: Debtor eligibility rule (country, product, min days overdue, next_contact_at)
nodes.norm_label: debtor eligibility rule (country, product, min days overdue, next_contact_at)
nodes.rationale: Eligible if country and product match, days_overdue >= min_days_overdue and next_contact_at is null or past; oldest debt first, then largest.

nodes.label: Call outcomes (no answer / promise in N days / refuses)
nodes.norm_label: call outcomes (no answer / promise in n days / refuses)

nodes.label: LLMCallEngine (planned AI replacement)
nodes.rationale: Same signature async run(agent: AgentSnapshot, debtor: DebtorSnapshot) -> CallResult, returns engine='llm', selected in lifespan.

nodes.label: CallEngine port (swappable call emulation)
nodes.rationale: Calls are a random emulation with injectable seed behind a CallEngine port so an LLM engine can replace it later without touching place_call, the dispatcher, the API or the frontend.

nodes.label: Version pins: SQLAlchemy <2.1, TypeScript 5.x
nodes.rationale: opentelemetry-instrumentation-sqlalchemy does not instrument SQLAlchemy 2.1 yet; openapi-typescript uses the TS 5 compiler API.

nodes.label: Injected random.Random and clock (get_call_engine, get_clock)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic tests; with SIMULATION_SEED the demo is reproducible.

nodes.label: Post-call requeue policy via next_contact_at
nodes.rationale: No answer -> 30 min; refuses -> 7 days; promise -> one day after promised date. A single next_contact_at column captures retry, cooldown and promise to keep the eligibility query simple.

nodes.label: Single asyncio dispatcher loop (one call per active agent per tick)
nodes.norm_label: single asyncio dispatcher loop (one call per active agent per tick)
nodes.rationale: Agent state lives in the DB and only one dispatcher runs, so it survives restarts and has no races; uvicorn runs without --workers because N workers would mean N dispatchers. Calls are sequential with one commit per call so two agents can't call the same debtor. 'Llamar ahora' reuses place_call.

nodes.label: Negotiation style profiles (suave / flexible / rigido)
nodes.rationale: Suave: installment plan, P(promise)=0.70, 15-30 days, 100% balance. Flexible: discount for payment, 0.55, 7-15 days, balance minus 10-30%. Rigido: full immediate payment, 0.40, 1-5 days, 100% balance.

nodes.label: Call emulation model (ANSWER_RATE 0.65, style-dependent promise)
nodes.rationale: Answering does not depend on negotiation style (style doesn't make someone pick up). If answered, outcome depends on style profile; debtors >90 days overdue get -0.15 promise probability. Emulation never touches the balance.

nodes.label: Immutable snapshots passed to CallEngine (not ORM models)
nodes.norm_label: immutable snapshots passed to callengine (not orm models)
nodes.rationale: Engine cannot touch the DB, is testable without a session, and an LLM engine would receive exactly the same input.

nodes.label: Test strategy (HTTP E2E, engine unit tests, direct tick())
nodes.norm_label: test strategy (http e2e, engine unit tests, direct tick())
nodes.rationale: FixedOutcomeEngine and FrozenClock test persistence/retry rules without waiting; engine tests check seed reproducibility and rigido < flexible < suave promise rates; dispatcher tested by calling tick() directly without sleep or background task.

nodes.label: Money as Numeric/Decimal, string in JSON
nodes.norm_label: money as numeric/decimal, string in json
nodes.rationale: Never use float for amounts.

nodes.label: migrations job (alembic round-trip + seed vs Postgres 16)
nodes.norm_label: migrations job (alembic round-trip + seed vs postgres 16)
nodes.rationale: Runs upgrade -> check -> downgrade -> upgrade against a real Postgres 16 to prove migrations are reversible and match the models; then runs the seed on the migrated DB.

nodes.label: py executor (cimg/python:3.14)
nodes.rationale: Python image version pinned to match requires-python in pyproject.toml and the Dockerfile FROM.

nodes.label: docker-compose.yml (kleva stack)
nodes.rationale: kleva_ container prefix and configurable host ports so the stack coexists with other local projects.

nodes.label: alloy service (Docker log collector)
nodes.rationale: security_opt label=disable so SELinux allows reading the Docker socket.

nodes.label: backend service (uvicorn app.main:app, single process)
nodes.rationale: Single process => single call dispatcher (no --workers). Fixed container name kleva_backend because Loki queries use it.

nodes.label: migrate service (alembic upgrade head)
nodes.rationale: Same kleva-backend image as backend; runs migrations once before backend starts.

nodes.label: Tempo datasource (traces->logs Loki, service map Prometheus)
nodes.norm_label: tempo datasource (traces->logs loki, service map prometheus)

nodes.label: Loki config (single-node, filesystem TSDB, structured metadata)
nodes.norm_label: loki config (single-node, filesystem tsdb, structured metadata)

nodes.label: Grafana dashboard generated as code (build_dashboard.py)
nodes.rationale: To change the dashboard, edit the script, not the UI.

nodes.label: Layered architecture api -> services -> crud -> models
nodes.norm_label: layered architecture api -> services -> crud -> models
nodes.rationale: Thin routers testable via HTTP; SQL lives only in crud/.

nodes.label: Non-default host ports and kleva_* container names
nodes.norm_label: non-default host ports and kleva_* container names
nodes.rationale: Avoid default ports (5432, 8000, 3000, 9090) so the stack coexists with other local stacks; all configurable via .env.

nodes.label: Enums stored as VARCHAR (native_enum=False)
nodes.rationale: Adding a value does not require ALTER TYPE and works the same on the SQLite used in tests.

nodes.label: UTCDateTime TypeDecorator decision
nodes.rationale: Postgres returns tz-aware datetimes and SQLite does not; the app always sees UTC-aware values.

nodes.label: Auth: OAuth2 password + JWT HS256 + Argon2id, constant-time login
nodes.norm_label: auth: oauth2 password + jwt hs256 + argon2id, constant-time login
nodes.rationale: FastAPI/Swagger standard; constant message and timing on login so existing emails are not revealed. No public user registration: users come from the seed.

nodes.label: Frontend types generated from OpenAPI, labels from /catalogs
nodes.norm_label: frontend types generated from openapi, labels from /catalogs
nodes.rationale: Backend is the single source of contracts and enums.
